heroHeadline: Day 729: Sheinbaum Marks Two Years in Office, Condemns Vandalism of Calderón Statue
heroSubtitle: On October 1, 2026, two years into her presidency, Sheinbaum said she disagreed with the decapitation of Felipe Calderón's statue at Los Pinos, criticised his role in the Free Americas Forum, thanked AMLO for his book-presentation video and explained the nationality reform for gubernatorial candidates.
